title: I lost my phone: what you can do now
pageTitle: I lost my phone: what you can do now | Spamlock
description: Lost or stolen phone? Steps you can take now: find, lock or erase it, block the SIM, change your passwords and report it.
answer: Find or lock your phone from another device, then call your mobile provider to block the SIM. Change your passwords, starting with your email.
stepsTitle: Steps you can take if you lost your phone

steps.title: Find, lock or erase it
steps.text: Open Find My (iPhone) or Find Hub (Android) below, from another phone or a computer. You’ll see where the phone is and can lock it with a message on screen. Erasing can’t be undone, so it’s usually the last thing to try.

steps.title: Block the SIM
steps.text: Call your mobile provider and ask them to block it, so no one can use your number for calls, texts or sign-in codes.

steps.title: Change your passwords
steps.text: Start with your email, because it can reset your other passwords. Then your bank and social accounts.

steps.title: Report it to the police
steps.text: Insurers often ask for the report.

steps.title: Watch for strange messages
steps.text: And for sign-in emails you don’t expect.

app.title: This guide is in the Spamlock app
app.text: Mark each step as done as you go.
